# Welcome to Nexus (UX prototype)

This is a **review pane**. Select any text in it and a comment box appears. Leave a comment, and tick *Ask agent* to have the agent reply in the thread.

## Things to try

- Ask the agent to *"set up a layout for the pantry sheet with a terminal"*.
- Open `pantry.csv`, sort by **Best before**, and ask *"what's about to expire?"*
- Ask *"what's the Wi-Fi password?"* The answer goes to a secure pane, never through the agent.
- Ask *"make me a pane that shows my homelab's disk usage as bars"*.

## A passage to comment on

The prototype tests the experience only. The backend choices in it are placeholders, and none of them is settled. Comment on this paragraph to try the suggestion flow: ask the agent to make it shorter.
